authority: pipeline-health's wake-gated answer cache for the lead-merge-unqueued status and reviews reads (BH-10349)
note: state/ph-lu-memo/<owner>_<repo>/<n>-<status|reviews>.json and .meta: the last GitHub (or PR record) answer, written by phlu_put (bin/lib/ph-lu-memo.sh) through wb_cache_put (bin/lib/wake-backstop.sh), meta <head sha>\t<read start epoch>. Served only for the same head, with no checks (status) or pr (reviews) wake since the read started, inside PH_LU_MEMO_BACKSTOP_S. phlu_gc deletes files older than 3 days once per run. Losing the directory costs one read per key. Machine-local, never carried
